audience.programmeDescription: Groningen’s Pedagogy and Educational Sciences route studies how children develop at home, at school and in the wider community. Students learn to evaluate educational and family support and apply research methods in workshops, an internship and a thesis.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers child development, language acquisition, social research and school-based projects. Groningen brings these areas together through sustained study of upbringing, family support and educational design and evaluation. The table shows the complete Groningen route.

componentNotes.common-04: The research practicum includes two Academic Learning Communities assignments.
componentNotes.workshop-01: One of two selected research workshops.
componentNotes.workshop-02: One of two selected research workshops.
componentNotes.thesis: Before starting, complete all 60 EC in year one and at least 40 EC from years two and three.
